minimum.source: 29 Del. C. section 4805 as amended; Delaware Lottery states all games must return between 87% and 95% of wagers annually
minimum.notes: Not less than 87% of total proceeds on an AVERAGE ANNUAL basis. This is an annual-average obligation, structurally different from a per-game theoretical floor. Charitable video lottery machines: not less than 60% and not greater than 86% annually (29 Del. C. section 4819A, MEDIUM). Whether the 87-95% band applies to iGaming is UNVERIFIED.

selfExclusion.notes: Entering a gaming area while on the list is a Class A misdemeanour, and winnings collected while listed are subject to FORFEITURE. Relevant to incident handling: see steering/incident-malfunction-handling.md section 4.1.

requirement.value: Internet lottery games may not be conducted unless the software or equipment can verify the player is physically present in the State

recentChanges.change: Final regulations adopted revising in-person enrollment and removal requirements for self-exclusion under 10 DE Admin. Code 203 (28 DE Reg 665)

consultantNotes: Delaware's RTP obligation is expressed as an ANNUAL AVERAGE across proceeds, not a per-game theoretical percentage. That is an operator-level reporting obligation as much as a game design constraint, and it changes who owns compliance.

Delaware is a small market operating on a lottery-led model. Confirm whether the product is being supplied to the Lottery rather than to a commercial operator, because that changes the contracting and approval path.
